name: tlor
displayName: TLOR Agents — a Middle-earth fellowship for Claude Code
description: Orchestration framework for Claude Code: fourteen Middle-earth-themed subagent roles plus an Explore backup mirror, dispatch rules, judgment rubrics, risk tiers, and the /tlor-init setup skill. Roles pin model/effort/tools by design; rules enforce delegation discipline and verification.

fellowship.title: Fellowship pane
fellowship.description: auto opens the pane on the first subagent; manual opens it only with /fellowship; off disables the fellowship mod.

fellowship_max_rows.title: Fellowship pane rows
fellowship_max_rows.description: Maximum number of agent rows shown in the Fellowship pane.

stdd_progress.title: STDD progress band
stdd_progress.description: Shows the newest unfinished STDD change and execute-task progress above the prompt.

plan_progress.title: Plan progress band
plan_progress.description: Shows the main conversation's active task-list progress above the prompt when no unfinished STDD change exists.

plan_reminder.title: Plan reminder
plan_reminder.description: After a plan is approved, reminds the model to keep a tickable step list in the plan file, unless another plugin already did.

plan_autoclose_s.title: Plan completion delay
plan_autoclose_s.description: Seconds to keep a completed plan visible before hiding it; 0 keeps it visible.

notify.title: Completion notifications
notify.description: Shows a toast or plays the bundled sound with a toast when tracked work completes.
